early_stop_reason: Stopped around iteration 1050 because no episode achieved even 5mm lift.
recommendation: Restore the binary lifting_object reward for the next isolated fresh run; keep the other rewards unchanged.
reviewer_a: Binary `lifting_object` was not redundant. Fresh training learned reach and close, but never produced object motion, so lift progress and bowl transport never had useful signal. Best next isolated move: restore the previous binary lift milestone unchanged.
reviewer_b: The dense lift progress term is too sparse as the first-lift bootstrap signal. It may shape height after motion starts, but it did not teach the first grasp/lift transition. Reintroduce a binary lift-acquisition signal.
